newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Krka to invest $10 mln in Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Krka to invest $10 mln in Croatia.

text.p: Slovenian drug producer Krka said on Wednesday it would construct a $10 million factory near the Croatian capital of Zagreb by mid-1999.

"The building of our production and distribution centre will start at the beginning of next year and will be completed in 16 months," Peter Jerman, Krka's manager of new projects and investments, told Reuters.
He said the new factory would produce drugs which are not made by the Croatian industry and will mainly be sold in Croatia.

"Currently we are building a similar $10 million plant in Poland, which would bring our products closer to Polish buyers and is expected to be finished next year. We also plan to start a similar project in Russia," Jerman said.

Krka also said it would build a new tablet factory near its headquarters in Novo Mesto, 70 kilometers (42 miles) south-east of Ljubljana, by the end of 1999. The construction would cost at least $9.5 million. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
